# Read raw data
```{r}
cs_raw <- read_csv(“data/true/caffeine_sensitivity.csv”)


intolerances <- c(
  “hisztaminintolerancia” = “histamine_int”,
  “gluténintolerancia” = “gluten_int”,
  “laktózintolerancia” = “lactose_int”,
  “tartósítószerekre adott intolerancia” = “preservatives_int”,
  “mesterséges színezékekre adott intolerancia” = “artificialcolors_int”,
  “ízfokozókra adott intolerancia” = “flavorenhancers_int”,
  “csokoládéintolerancia” = “chocolate_int”,
  “mesterséges édesítőszerekre adott intolerancia” = “artificialsweeteners_int”,
  “alkoholintolerancia” = “alcohol_int”,
  “gyógyszerintolerancia (bármilyen)” = “drugs_int”)
```

# Clean data
```{r}
cs_clean <-
  cs_raw |>
  clean_names() |>
  select(-c(ip_address, status, recipient_last_name:consent_form)) |>

  mutate(caff_sens = case_when( str_detect(caff_sens, “Igen”) ~ 1,
                                str_detect(caff_sens, “Nem”) ~ 0,
                                TRUE ~ NA_real_),
         across(c(starts_with(“caff_intox”),
                  starts_with(“cerq”),
                  starts_with(“sss”),
                  starts_with(“pms”),
                  starts_with(“maia”),
                  starts_with(“hexaco”),
                  starts_with(“asps”),
                  starts_with(“psrs”),
                  starts_with(“berq”),
                  children,
                  ),
                 parse_number),
         honesty_report = case_when(honesty_report == “Igen” ~ “Yes”,
                                    honesty_report == “Nem”  ~ “No”,
                                    TRUE ~ NA_character_),
         gender = case_when(str_detect(gender, “Nő”) ~ “Female”,
                            str_detect(gender, “Férfi”) ~ “Male”,
                            str_detect(gender, “Egyéb”) ~ “Other/Undisclosed”,
                            TRUE ~ NA_character_),
         occupation = case_when(str_detect(occupation, “Tanuló”) ~ “Student”,
                                str_detect(occupation, “Alkalmazott”) ~ “Employee”,
                                str_detect(occupation, “Vállalkozó”) ~ “Entrepreneur”,
                                TRUE ~ NA_character_),
         uni_work = case_when(str_detect(uni_work, “0”) ~ “No”,
                              str_detect(uni_work, “1”) ~ “Yes”,
                              TRUE ~ NA_character_),
         smoking_status = case_when(str_detect(smoking_status, “0”) ~ “No”,
                                    str_detect(smoking_status, “alkalmanként”) ~ “Occasionally”,
                                    str_detect(smoking_status, “rendszeresen”) ~ “Regularly”,
                                    TRUE ~ NA_character_),
         across(ph_activity_1:ph_activity_3, ~ case_when(str_detect(., “0 óra”) ~ 0,
                                                         str_detect(., “0- 1 óra”) ~ .5,
                                                         str_detect(., “1 -  2 óra”) ~ 1.5,
                                                         str_detect(., “2 - 3 óra”) ~ 2.5,
                                                         str_detect(., “4 - 5 óra”) ~ 4.5,
                                                         str_detect(., “6 - 8 óra”) ~ 7,
                                                         str_detect(., “8 óra fölött”) ~ 8,
                                                         TRUE ~ NA_real_)),
         caffeine_perday = case_when(str_detect(caffeine_perday, “nem fogyasztok koffeint”) ~ “No caffaine”,
                                     (parse_number(caffeine_perday) == 1 |
                                     parse_number(caffeine_perday) == 25 |
                                     parse_number(caffeine_perday) == 55 |
                                     parse_number(caffeine_perday) == 80 |
                                     parse_number(caffeine_perday) == 100 |
                                     parse_number(caffeine_perday) == 130) ~ “0-160 mg/day”,
                                     (parse_number(caffeine_perday) == 160 |
                                     parse_number(caffeine_perday) == 240) ~ “160-320 mg/day”,
                                     (parse_number(caffeine_perday) == 320 |
                                     parse_number(caffeine_perday) == 400) ~ “More than 320 mg/day”,
                                     TRUE ~ NA_character_),
         across(starts_with(“other_int”), ~recode(., !!!intolerances))
         ) |>
  rename_with(.fn = function(x) {
    sapply(x, function(colname) {
      first_val <- cs_raw[[colname]] |> na.omit() |> first()
      recode(first_val, !!!intolerances)
    })
  }, .cols = starts_with(“other_int”)) |>
  mutate(
    across(starts_with(“histamine_int”):starts_with(“drugs_int”), ~ if_else(!is.na(.), 1, 0))
    ) |>
  select(PARTICIPANT_ID = participant_id, everything())
```

# Calculate composite scores based on a key table
```{r}
keys <- range_read(“1PfxCFjF23NyndTDsx6dYHHjcwlxpXuLhuZGlgPQqaaQ”)
```

## Look up reverse items (except for SSS, which are all reverse scored)
```{r}
reversing_lookup <- keys |>
  filter(reversed == TRUE, !str_detect(item, “^sss_“)) |>
  mutate(reverse_const = scale_min + scale_max) |>
  select(item, reverse_const) |>
  deframe()

cs_clean <- cs_clean |>
  mutate(across(
    any_of(names(reversing_lookup)),
    ~ reversing_lookup[[cur_column()]] - .x
  ))

items_long <-
  cs_clean |>
  select(PARTICIPANT_ID, any_of(keys$item)) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = -PARTICIPANT_ID, names_to = “item”, values_to = “value”) |>
  left_join(keys, by = “item”) |>
  mutate(value_ordered = value)
```

## Calculate scales and subscales in long format
```{r}
scales <- items_long |>
  group_by(PARTICIPANT_ID, scale_id) |>
  summarise(mean = mean(value_ordered, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = “drop”) |>
  drop_na(scale_id)

subscales <- items_long |>
  group_by(PARTICIPANT_ID, subscale_id) |>
  summarise(mean = mean(value_ordered, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = “drop”) |>
  drop_na(subscale_id)
```

## Pivot to wide format
```{r}
scales_wide <- scales |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = scale_id, values_from = mean)

subscales_wide <- subscales |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = subscale_id, values_from = mean)
```

## Merge scales and subscales
```{r}
cs_scores <- scales_wide |>
  left_join(subscales_wide, by = “PARTICIPANT_ID”)
```

## Update cs_clean with the new scores
```{r}
cs_clean <- cs_clean |>
  left_join(cs_scores, by = “PARTICIPANT_ID”)
```

# Calculate other composite scored
```{r}
cs_clean <- cs_clean |>
  mutate(
    other_int_count = rowSums(across(ends_with(“_int”)), na.rm = TRUE),
    physical_activity_score = ph_activity_1 + ph_activity_2 + ph_activity_3*2,
    caff_intox_mean = rowMeans(across(c(caff_intox_1:caff_intox_12)), na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

# Exclusion
```{r}
cs_clean <- cs_clean |>
  filter(
    # Must have non-missing caff_sens
    !is.na(caff_sens),
    # Must have all 12 caff_intox items non-missing
    if_all(caff_intox_1:caff_intox_12, ~ !is.na(.)),
    # Attention checks must match expected answers
    att_check_1 == 1,
    att_check_2 == 2,
    att_check_3 == 3,
    # Honesty report must be “yes”
    honesty_report == “Yes”
  )

write_csv(cs_clean, “data/true/caffeine_sensitivity_clean.csv”)
```
